team.title: Team
team.subtitle: People in your organization and what they can access.
team.readOnlyHint: Administrator accounts can only be changed by the platform team.

empty.title: No people found
empty.body: Try a different search or filter, or add your first HR user.

add_dialog.title: Add an HR user
add_dialog.body: They get a one-time temporary password and must choose a new one at first sign-in.
add_dialog.name: Full name

tempPassword.title: Temporary password
tempPassword.body: Share this password with {{name}} now. It is shown only once and they must change it at first sign-in.

deactivate_dialog.title: Deactivate {{name}}?
deactivate_dialog.body: They can no longer sign in. Their data is kept and nothing is deleted. You can reactivate them later.

confirm.resetBody: A new temporary password replaces the current one and they are signed out.
confirm.signOutBody: All their active sessions end immediately.
confirm.reactivateBody: They can sign in again with their current password.
